### BalanceToggle

32 px circular eye button that shows or masks the wallet balance.

Level: atom · Part of: UserGreeting

Use when:
- Inside UserGreeting to hide or show balances
- Wherever wallet or portfolio amounts need a privacy toggle

Don't use when:
- For password reveal use Input's own affordance
- For general icon actions use IconButton

Accessibility: Label switches between «إظهار الرصيد» and «إخفاء الرصيد»; toggle button with pressed state.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| State | `state` | variant | Show, Hide | Show |

### MoneyAmount

Number plus Saudi riyal symbol atom; the symbol trails in LTR and leads in RTL. Reused across the whole product for every riyal amount.

Level: atom · Part of: WalletChip, ReturnsDisplay, Calculator / Metric row, Calculator / Amount display, Reinvest / MaturityRecap, Keypad / Amount hero

Use when:
- Any SAR amount: balances, profits, payout totals
- Size=lg Tone=brand for headline received or returns amounts

Don't use when:
- Never write the word ريال beside a number; use this
- For percentages use plain text styles or Calculator / Stat tile

Accessibility: Expose as «5,000 ريال سعودي» for screen readers; Western digits.

Compliance: Tone=brand (green) only for profit or money received.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amount | `amount` | text |  | 5,000 |
| Size | `size` | variant | sm, lg | sm |
| Tone | `tone` | variant | default, brand, muted | default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### RollingDigit

Odometer digit: a clipped 0–9 strip. Change Digit inside a smart-animated variant switch and the strip rolls to the new number. Direction-neutral.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

### RollingAmount

Rolling money amount (odometer) built from 6 RollingDigit instances (D0 hidden by default, show it for 100,000+) + comma + Riyal icon. Set each D1–D5 Digit; swap variants with Smart animate (Gentle) and every digit rolls. D1–D5 cover 10,000–99,999; show D0 for 6 digits, hide D1 for 4 digits.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Size | `size` | variant | lg, md | lg |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

PortfolioHeader is the top section of the investor’s Portfolio page. It greets the user, shows the (maskable) wallet balance, the total returns alongside the amount invested, and a button into the payouts schedule.

> **Info:** Composed atoms → molecules → organism. Content (name, amounts) is edited on the nested molecule / atom instances; the organism carries Direction, the Balance state, and the visibility booleans.

### When to use

Use once, at the very top of the Portfolio page - it is an identity + summary header, not a generic card.

- PortfolioHeader - the portfolio page’s greeting + wallet + returns summary.
- For a single stat elsewhere, use Stat (04f) or KeyValue (04g), not this.
- Wallet balance can be hidden for privacy via Balance = Masked (the eye toggles it).

### Atomic architecture

### Atoms

- MoneyAmount - a number + Riyal, Size (sm / lg) × Tone (default / brand / muted) × Direction (Riyal trails in LTR, leads in RTL). Editable Amount.
- BalanceToggle - the 32×32 circular eye button, State Show / Hide.

### Molecules (each Direction LTR / RTL)

- UserGreeting - qualified badge + name + BalanceToggle. WalletChip - green “Wallet” label + white balance chip (MoneyAmount). ReturnsDisplay - label + big amount, with the amount-invested block on the opposite side.

### Organism

- PortfolioHeader - UserGreeting + WalletChip (top row) + ReturnsDisplay + payouts Button.

### Anatomy

The atoms and molecules that compose the header. Select a nested part to edit its text (name, amounts).

### Properties

### Variants

- Direction - LTR / RTL. RTL mirrors layout, moves the wallet to the left, right-aligns Arabic (Tajawal), and flips the Riyal to lead the number.
- Balance - Shown / Masked. Masked replaces the wallet balance with ••••• and flips the eye to “show”.

### Booleans

- Show wallet · Show returns · Show payouts table - toggle the wallet chip, the returns block, and the CTA button.

### Text (on the nested parts)

- Name (UserGreeting) · Wallet balance (via the balance MoneyAmount’s Amount) · Returns amount / Invested amount (ReturnsDisplay’s MoneyAmounts) · Returns label / Invested label.

### Direction & states

The four variants: LTR / RTL × Shown / Masked balance.
